EPISODE 2 OF FREE LONDON 🌿 This might be one of the most underrated free things to do in London… The Barbican Conservatory is a hidden tropical oasis right in the middle of the city, with 1,500+ species of plants and trees growing inside the iconic Barbican. 🌴 And the best part? It’s completely FREE. 🤍 📍 Barbican Centre 🎟️ Free, but you need to book a timed ticket 🌿 Open on selected dates only P.S. It’s due to close in 2027 for a major restoration, so go while you can! Save this one for your London bucket list 🫶🏻 #FreeLondon #LondonThingsToDo #LondonOnABudget #Barbican #londonguide

items.desc: EPISODE 1 OF FREE LONDON 🫶🏻 Starting with the Design Museum 🎨 Did you know you can visit the Design Museum completely free? The permanent collection Designer Maker User is free to enter, with almost 1,000 objects exploring everything from architecture and fashion to technology and graphics. 📍 Kensington 🎟️ Free entry — no booking needed ⏰ Mon–Thu 10am–5pm | Fri–Sun 10am–6pm Saving you money, one London spot at a time 🤝🏻 #FreeLondon #LondonThingsToDo #LondonOnABudget #LondonMuseums #londonguide

Your sign to visit the Barbican Conservatory before it closes 🌿 One of my favourite hidden spots in London — I genuinely can’t believe this tropical little oasis is right in the middle of the city 🥹 It’s completely free, SO pretty and the perfect place to wander around for an hour or two. Definitely one to add to your London bucket list before it closes! 📍Barbican Conservatory, London #London #Barbican #LondonHiddenGems #LondonThingsToDo #VisitLondon
